One of my favorite games growing up was Paper Mario and the Thousand Year Old Door on the Nintendo Gamecube
You should totally check out 'This War of Mine'. Makes you see war in a whole new way.
If we're talking about Super Nintendo classics, you can't go wrong with Donkey Kong Country. A must-play for anyone who likes retro games.
*I recommend my all-time favorite game, _Disco Elysium._ It's on PC and Consoles.*
I recommend The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker on GameCube. It's a masterpiece with such a beautiful story.
Talking about Nintendo games, one of my favorites is _Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin_. But if we’re talking more generally, without a doubt, _Marvel’s Spider-Man_ is the best.

Apex Legends is my favorite battle royale game

My favorite show is Breaking Bad, I highly suggest it if you haven't seen it before.

One of my favorite shows is 'Whose Line Is It Anyway?'
It's super funny and all improvised, definitely worth checking out if you haven’t seen it.

I have to recommend Game of Thrones, in my opinion, it's the best series of all time, and everyone should watch it. The story is epic, full of political intrigue and twists that will leave you shocked. If you haven't seen it yet, you're missing out.
That's a good suggetion <@U093FRRTEDS>, I still haven't watched that one yet. I still haven't watched Squid Games either. Sometimes you just gotta save the good ones for later!

Oh since we are talking about anime, I always loved Death Note. I didn't like the movie with Nat Wolff though.

I'm always watching the anime _Samurai Champloo_
